caption: The drawing contains four distinct ornamental designs, all rendered in teal blue, pale yellow, and red-orange against a beige, aged parchment-like background. The upper left object has an ovular, diamond-patterned top with a small circle at its peak, attached to a flower-shaped form with two downward curved petals and an arching lower motif that encloses a small teal circle. The upper right object displays a larger, symmetrical stylized plant form with a diamond-patterned vertical center, flanked by small, spiky blue flowers and curved, elongated leaf shapes. Below, at the bottom left, there is a large, swirling, foliate design featuring a sweeping curve filled with alternating colored bands of pale yellow and teal, ending with a circular teal and red-orange accent; next to it is a small four-pointed star with alternating teal dots and pale yellow triangles around a red-orange dot. All designs are bordered in the red-orange color, and the overall arrangement is spacious, with each motif separated from the others. There is small typed text at the bottom giving a title and location reference, “ALtar Dome - San Juan Capistrano Mission,” with a line reading “Decorative Art of Spanish California” at the very bottom left.
title: San Juan Capistrano Altar Dome from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
